summary_rationale: KORU (Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X Shares) is not an operating compounder; it is a single-day, 3x leveraged derivative wrapper managed by Rafferty Asset Management, LLC. Its structural economics are cleanly engineered—combining physical iShares MSCI South Korea ETF (EWY) shares (50.9% of FY2025 net assets), Treasury/government money market collateral (44.6%), and diversified OTC total return swaps across four Tier-1 dealers (Bank of America Merrill Lynch, Citibank, Barclays, J.P. Morgan) at SOFR + 60 to 85 bps. Operational KPIs pass on liquidity ($985.42M AUM, 32.57M avg daily share volume) and collateral yield coverage ($3.81M FY2025 investment income vs. $1.80M net expenses), warranting PASS_WITH_WATCH. However, the watch flags are structural: 3x daily reset embeds quadratic volatility drag in sideways or choppy regimes (evidenced by FY2022's -76.86% NAV drawdown and the Feb 2025 1-for-10 reverse split), total audited costs reach 1.68% of average net assets including broker interest (and 1.32% prospectus expense ratio with AFFE), and the underlying MSCI Korea 25/50 Index remains heavily concentrated (42-48%) in the Samsung Electronics / SK Hynix memory-chip duopoly.
